killedBy: resetDeveloperData (issue #249) removes every developer key and leaves every production key byte-identical
resetDeveloperData (issue #249) leaves an unrelated key alone, not just the ones the game owns
why: Resets EVERY key instead of the developer namespace, so Reset Developer Data wipes the player's real campaign, stats, achievements and customization -- the most damaging thing this pane could do, under a button whose label promises the opposite. Issue #249's third criterion is exactly this. The scoping is structural (the developer `clear()` walks only prefixed names) and this entry is what stops that being true only until someone reaches for the base storage, which is one identifier away. It also drove a REFACTOR: the first draft bound this inline in `loop.ts`'s browser wiring, and the harness refused the entry because nothing in the suite reaches that file -- a mutation there could only ever report SURVIVES. The most destructive line in the feature was the one that could not be pinned, so it moved behind `resetDeveloperData` where it can be.
